text_to_image_prompt: Photorealistic wardrobe product photograph. Pure white seamless background and soft neutral studio lighting. No person, skin, body parts, visible mannequin or stand. Entire objects visible, faithful texture. 奶油米色宽松短袖开领亚麻衬衫，奶油米色抽绳亚麻长裤卷裤脚，不加鞋。仅服装与鞋袜；无可拆卸配饰。
original_prompt: Use case: product-mockup. Create one standalone photorealistic wardrobe catalogue image from this reference outfit, GARMENTS ONLY: men's cream beige linen loose short-sleeved open camp-collar button shirt, matching cream beige linen drawstring trousers with loosely rolled cuffs. Preserve visible fabric texture, oversized relaxed fit and colors. No shoes because the reference is barefoot. Pure white seamless background and soft neutral studio lighting, portrait 2:3, all garments uncropped, hollow invisible-mannequin display. Absolutely NO person, skin, face, body parts, visible mannequin or supports. Remove sunglasses, necklace and hat; no other items, no text, no watermark, no beach. Reference is design input only.
reproduction_note: 依据用户附件制作白底无人商品图；原附件仅作参考。遮挡处、微小首饰和未展示结构采用保守补全，不代表品牌或精确商品鉴定。文字图案以视觉参考为主，未逐图重生成验证。
